symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: gateway-mock answers /authorize in about 9.3 s instead of immediately, so payment-service waits and order-service times out at about 3 s, leaving orders PAYMENT_PENDING while payment was authorized later.

evidence.why: gateway-mock logs its authorize answers taking about 10000 ms, showing the slow answer is its own.
Latency rose from no requests to a mean of 9.256 s on /authorize in the incident window, while gateway-mock showed no errors.
Order ec614f1d was left PAYMENT_PENDING after order-service timed out calling payment-service, which was waiting on gateway-mock.
